name: livingdocs
description: Keeps software documentation in permanent sync with code via lightweight @purpose/@requirement/@contract/@audience annotations. Bundles the livingdocs MCP server (analyze_change, get_status, get_contract, update_doc, generate_rollup, get_doc_history, bootstrap_repo), a contextual sync skill, and 7 explicit slash commands (/livingdocs:scan, status, update, generate, contract, history, bootstrap) for discoverability.
